purpose: 解释器、包来源、pip / pytest 版本、激活文件、工作区初态
cmd: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import datalad; print("datalad", datalad.__file__)'; (cd / && python -c 'import datalad; print("cwd=/ datalad", datalad.__file__)'); git --version; command -v git-annex || echo 'no git-annex on PATH'; command -v datalad || echo 'no datalad console script on PATH'; python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?

purpose: 公开读者建议命令（public_read.md 第 1 个命令块）
cmd:
GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=tester GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=tester@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=tester GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=tester@example.com python - <<'EOF'
import sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "/testbed")
from datalad.api import create
from datalad.cli.main import main
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dl-exit-")
create(dataset=d, annex=False, result_renderer="disabled")
cases = [
    ["run", "--explicit", "exit 3"],
    ["run", "exit 3"],
    ["run", "--explicit", "exit 0"],
    ["run", "--explicit", "-i", "does-not-exist", "exit 3"],
    ["--on-failure", "ignore", "run", "--explicit", "exit 3"],
]
for args in cases:
    try:
        main(["datalad", "-C", d] + args)
    except SystemExit as e:
        print("ARGS", args, "EXIT", e.code, flush=True)
EOF

purpose: 公开读者建议命令（public_read.md 第 2 个命令块）
cmd:
GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=tester GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=tester@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=tester GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=tester@example.com python - <<'EOF'
import sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "/testbed")
from datalad.api import create
from datalad.utils import chpwd
from datalad.cli.tests.test_main import run_main
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dl-exit-")
create(dataset=d, annex=False, result_renderer="disabled")
with chpwd(d):
    run_main(["run", "--explicit", "exit 3"], exit_code=3)
print("run_main(exit_code=3) passed")
EOF

purpose: 公开读者建议命令（public_read.md 第 5 个命令块）
cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=tester GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=tester@example.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=tester GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=tester@example.com datalad create --no-annex "$d" && datalad -C "$d" run --explicit 'exit 3'; echo "exit=$?"
